highlights: We believe useful AI systems require two fundamental capabilities: the ability to perform meaningful actions autonomously (Automation) and the ability to find and retrieve the right information (Semantic Search).
Minds Anton - Self-improving Automation Agent that can get any type of work done.
Minds Query Engine - Semantic Search query engine, used to index and organize large amounts of data from hundreds of structured and unstructured datasources.
